Subject: parabolic PDE | ID: 62529

Step 3. The subharmonic operator \(V_{01290013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01290013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the analytic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
